_doc: SEED-LIFECYCLE-1 answers for intent-yield: served by the site Worker at /yield and /yield.json, run daily by intent-yield.yml. Read by foundation/seedlife.py.

models.why: makes no model calls: verdicts come from running repository checks and restatements from word overlap, so no hosted model can retire under it

health.how: the watchdog fetches the verify URL every pass; a failing reading reopens Q-SEED and the handoff closer rolls back

privacy.why: stores no personal data: its inputs are the owner's directives already public in agents/AGENTS.md and the exit codes of repository checks; no visitor, contact or account data is read or kept
